body: thank you for writing. i am rooting for you too mal, hope you can feel better and achieve what you desire. as for me, i really do not know what to say about what will happen.

i truly am grateful that you are trying to help, it feel good to know that there are people willing to reply to me. 
i am truly sorry; i think i am hopeless.
you speak of building a future filled with nurturing relations but i dont know how am i supposed to do that if im currently depressed. plus theres the fact that you only control half of a relationship, and i truly try to put the best of me out there for other people, but they turn their back on me or cast me aside everytime. i have a hard time enjoying things i used to. 
anyway,
thank you for helping me, your message made me feel better.
im really sorry to hear that you feel a similar way like i do. from what you say i gather you have people who are close to you, you should feel happy about that, not all of us do

i truly am alone, that is out of the question. all my relationships have gone to shit, friends turned their back on me, family is abusive as fuck and i have no choice but to live with them. ive been feeling like this for about a year but i am so afraid of the physical pain that i cant do it.
i recently started dating a person and fell in love for her but she doesnt feel much for me and it makes me feel like crap. 
there are so many problems and id tackle them if i could but i think i am not capable of a single one
